usage: cli.py snapshot [-h] [--cfg CFG] --prices PRICES [--out OUT]
                       [--store STORE] [--no-clobber]
                       [--session {premarket,open,midday,close,afterhours}]
                       [--benchmarks BENCHMARKS] [--reasoning REASONING]
                       [--recent-change-window-days RECENT_CHANGE_WINDOW_DAYS]
                       [--inputs-hash INPUTS_HASH]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cfg CFG             Path to regime config
  --prices PRICES       Path to prices CSV
  --out OUT             Optional output JSON path
  --store STORE         Optional store directory
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
  --session {premarket,open,midday,close,afterhours}
  --benchmarks BENCHMARKS
                        Comma-separated benchmark list
  --reasoning REASONING
                        Reasoning bullet (repeatable)
  --recent-change-window-days RECENT_CHANGE_WINDOW_DAYS
                        Recent change window days
  --inputs-hash INPUTS_HASH
                        Optional inputs hash override
